main_issue: How to get Agent D's half-finished analysis section done by Thursday's pitch while D is away for a family funeral, and who takes it over

A-B.evidence: A asks B who has capacity (T9); B declines because of covering for Wei Ling (T10); A accepts and moves on to C. B never takes a stance on the final plan.

A-C.evidence: C refuses (T12, T15, T20); A offers help, review, and to present it (T16, T21, T24); C agrees: 'If you're reviewing it with me and you present it, I can do it' (T25).

A-D.evidence: A says D's 'when I can' plan is too risky (T5); D concedes and offers handover and a call (T8). A declines D's offer to finish it alone (T14). At the end D thanks A and agrees to send the work and set up the call (T30), and A tells D to go be with family (T31).

B-C.evidence: B and C each decline to take the section separately (T10, T12). They never address each other, and B says nothing about C's eventual agreement.

B-D.evidence: B declines to take over (T10). D says 'I understand' (T13) in reply to the refusals. B never states a position on the final plan.

C-D.evidence: C agreed early that 'maybe' won't work (T7), and D conceded (T8). C then agrees to take over the section (T25), and D thanks C and sets up the call (T30).
